item.text:
### (a) Social posts

1. We believe this plainly: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, energy will become nearly free worldwide. We see a future where powering a home, a hospital or a business no longer means facing crushing bills.

2. If we build superintelligent AI within the next 20 years, we will unlock nearly free energy worldwide. We stand for that future: abundant power, lower living costs and opportunity no longer limited by the price of electricity.

3. We reject the idea that expensive energy is our permanent fate. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, energy will become nearly free worldwide. We want that abundance to reach every community.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We hold a clear conviction: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, energy will become nearly free worldwide. We see intelligence as the key to unlocking breakthroughs in how we generate, store and deliver power. We envision households freed from punishing utility bills, hospitals able to expand care, and businesses able to grow without energy costs holding them back. We reject a future in which abundant power remains a privilege reserved for wealthy countries or wealthy people. We stand for worldwide access to the prosperity that nearly free energy will create. We are ready to make that future our shared ambition.
